Lane B runs both sides on the same raw inputs, so for an adapted function its verdict is no answer to the adapted claim: pick and shift witness on swapped arguments, and pad witnesses on null, an input of the candidate's wider type the parent never received; check.mjs records that verdict and lets lane A answer the adapted claim.
